verdict.rationale: Databricks documents Auto Loader for ETL pipelines and for incrementally processing new data files as they arrive in cloud storage, plus a guide for choosing ingestion connectors by data source, so the core of loading from object storage is covered. Nothing in the evidence shows explicit CSV/JSON/Parquet format support or a single documented bulk-load command. missing for 10: evidence of a single bulk-load command (e.g. a documented COPY-style statement), explicit CSV/JSON/Parquet format coverage, bulk (non-incremental) load semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
